description: The bar chart illustrates the average performance of various models on November 2024 AMC 10/12 tests. The horizontal axis lists the model names, including LLaMA-70b, Claude 3.5 Sonnet, Qwen 2.5 14b-instruct, GPT 4o, 4o-mini, Owen 2.5 72b-instruct, Gemini Flash 1.5, Gemini Pro 1.5, and phi-4, while the vertical axis represents the average score, ranging from 60 to 90 with a linear scale and tick labels at intervals of 10. Each model is represented by a pair of bars, with light blue indicating the "Large model" and dark blue representing the "Small model", although some models only have one bar. The average scores range from approximately 66.4 for LLaMA-70b to 91.8 for phi-4, with the bars generally increasing in height from left to right, and the models are not sorted in a specific order by their scores. The phi-4 model has the tallest bar, with a score of around 91.8, while LLaMA-70b has the shortest bar, with a score of approximately 66.4.
